title: Towards Pose-Robust Few-Shot Vision-Language-Action Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.24360v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Fine-tuning a vision-language-action (VLA) model on a few dozen demonstrations is the standard way to put a manipulation policy on a robot, yet the resulting policy silently assumes that the camera and the robot base stay exactly where they were during data collection: a bumped tripod or a base re-docked a few centimetres away makes it reach for the wrong place. We show that both failures are one phenomenon, a change of the camera-to-base extrinsic that the policy has memorised, and that the robot carries everything needed to undo it. We introduce WACO, a world-anchored canonicalization framework for VLA models: the arm, placed by forward kinematics at the measured joint angles, serves as a metric calibration target, and the static scene serves as the world anchor that tells a moved camera from a moved robot. translated_title: 迈向位姿鲁棒的少样本视觉-语言-动作模型
translated_abstract: 在几十条演示数据上微调视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，是将操作策略部署到机器人上的标准方法，然而由此得到的策略默认相机和机器人底座在数据采集后保持完全不动：一个被碰倒的三脚架，或底座仅被重新放置几厘米远，都会导致机器人伸向错误的位置。我们证明这两种失败其实是同一现象——即策略所记忆的相机-底座外参发生了变化——而机器人自身携带了解决这一问题所需的一切信息。我们提出WACO，一个面向VLA模型的世界锚定规范化框架：机械臂根据测量的关节角度通过正向运动学放置，充当度量校准目标；静态场景则充当世界锚点，用于区分相机移动与机器人移动。仅需单帧RGB-D图像，WACO无需真值外参或额外数据即可同时估计这两种位移，并将图像规范化为……
tldr: 提出WACO框架，利用机械臂正向运动学作为度量校准目标、静态场景作为世界锚点，仅凭单帧RGB-D图像即可估计并校正相机与底座的外参变化，使少样本VLA模型对位姿扰动具备鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: WACO is a world-anchored canonicalization framework that uses the arm's forward kinematics as a metric calibration target and the static scene as a world anchor, estimating camera and base shifts from a single RGB-D frame to make few-shot VLA models robust to extrinsic pose changes.
